sources.entry: Rhea - macOS status bar app for quickly sharing files and URLs.

summary.one_liner: Rhea is a macOS status bar utility for uploading files to Dropbox and shortening links via drag-and-drop or clipboard.
summary.what_it_does: Rhea is a Mac status bar app for quickly uploading files and shortening URLs. You can drag files onto the status bar icon, or upload a file path or file URL from the clipboard through the dropdown menu. Uploads go to Dropbox (via TJDropbox), and the Dropbox link is copied to the clipboard while the upload runs in the background. Links can be shortened the same way, by dragging them in or using a URL on the clipboard, through a custom URL shortening service. Uploaded filenames get a consistent 4-character base 62 suffix based on file contents, so re-uploading the same file with the same name does nothing new.
use_cases: share files quickly from the Mac menu bar
upload a file to Dropbox and get a shareable link
shorten a long URL from the clipboard
replacement for CloudApp or Dropshare style sharing
how_to_run: Fill in _dropboxAppKey in the source with your Dropbox app key
Add a URL scheme in Info.plist CFBundleURLTypes in the format db-yourDropboxAppKey
Stub out use of TJURLShortener (a private repo) for the URL shortening service
notable: Status bar drag-and-drop for both files and links
Dropbox links copied to clipboard while uploads proceed in background
Deterministic 4-character base 62 suffix avoids filename conflicts and makes repeat uploads no-ops
Recommends Dropbox selective sync to keep the Rhea folder off the Mac
caveats: The Dropbox app key and URL shortening service are not in the open source repo, so it will not run as-is; developers must supply them
TJURLShortener is a private repo that must be stubbed out for development
Requires a Dropbox account for file storage
